verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents automatic user provisioning that pushes changes made to Workspace user accounts out to third-party apps, which covers the directory-to-app-assignment leg of joiner/mover/leaver. Nothing shows an HRIS feeding the directory: the Directory and Cloud Identity APIs are developer building blocks, not an HR-driven sync. Missing for 10: a native HRIS-as-source-of-truth inbound connector, automated mover/leaver handling driven by HR attribute changes, documented deprovisioning flows, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, HR drives identity — the HRIS is the source of truth, and joiner/mover/leaver changes flow into the directory and app assignments automatically

citations.quote: אתם יכולים להגדיר הקצאת הרשאות אוטומטית למשתמשים כדי שכל השינויים שתבצעו בחשבונות המשתמשים ב-Google Workspace יסונכרנו אוטומטית עם אפליקציית הצד השלישי הזאת.
Puedes configurar el aprovisionamiento automático de usuarios para que los cambios que realices en las cuentas de usuario de Google Workspace se sincronicen automáticamente con esta app de terceros.
